description: Each chapter file contains topic-grouped multiple-choice questions for HSC Information and Communication Technology (ICT). ICT is a single compulsory subject in Bangladesh NCTB without 1st Paper or 2nd Paper division.

folder_structure.ict.json: Subject-level index containing chapter metadata and chapter files list.
folder_structure.chapter_01.json - chapter_06.json: Chapter-wise MCQ questions directly located under ICT directory.
